4960.title: Session identity is missing from the provider child environment
4960.rootCauseOneLine: The Codex child launch overlays only pool routing from session options and strips inherited BB variables; session identity reaches shell policy but not the spawned app-server.
4960.proposedFix: Review a provider-local allowlist restoring session-owned identity after inherited-environment sanitization, preserving thread-free and unrelated-variable isolation. No automatic PR because this changes a process isolation boundary.
4960.caveats: Real bridge and actual subprocess verified twice; upstream Codex MCP forwarding was not exercised. Complete test and observed output are embedded in the report; raw artifacts remain local per reports repository policy.
